text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...
I gave it everything... squeezed out every last drop...
I can't move anymore. But...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
With 200% full power... I won!
It might've been a fluke,
but I beat Bakushin O-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, Biko Pegasus won...!
Guess she really is pretty strong after all.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We might have finally found someone
who can give the undisputed queen of the sprint division,
Bakushin O, a real challenge.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Someone to prop up...
I see, even if I manage to win, Bakushin O-senpai is still way more popular...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I won't get discouraged!
Just like Carrotman!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite her youth, Biko Pegasus managed
to strike a decisive blow back against Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Biko-san! Congratulations on 1st place.
To think you'd push it this far...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You truly are the lively, spirited Umamusume I took you for!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Bakushin O-senpai!
I'll definitely win the next one too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Next, you say...? Hehe, indeed,
you won at 1200m today, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What would happen under slightly different conditions?
Like in a mile race, for instance.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A mile race... Which means...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll be waiting for you next
at the 1600m GⅠ, the Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A mile race, huh? Alright, let's go.
I'm gonna do this!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm going to beat the strongest, Bakushin O-senpai, at 1600m!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oops. I am certainly strong, but when it comes to 1600m,
there are other Umamusume who cannot be underestimated.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Never let your guard down, and never forget!
There's another boss in the current sprint division.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The other boss...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the first clash against Sakura Bakushin O concluded.
The challenge was carried over to the next mile race.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Today, I truly, truly
gave it everything I had... More than ever before...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
To stand against Bakushin O-senpai,
I even unlocked Overclock Mode...
choice_data_list: Yeah, maybe I pushed myself a bit too hard...
Yeah, maybe you pushed yourself a little too hard...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Overclocking. In other words, pushing for an unreasonable acceleration that one would normally avoid, just to compete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For Biko Pegasus, it must have been a big match she desperately wanted to win, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I feel like... everyone
was only looking at Bakushin O-senpai..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
My breathing is... so rough...
And my legs are hurting a bit... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A heavy strain suddenly placed on legs that were already fragile to begin with.
As expected, the price to pay—was not zero.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan, are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah, miss! You came!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the checkup ended, the action actress lady
went out of her way to come to the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: So, what were the test results?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, it's no big deal!
I just have to lay off intense training for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, a blessing in disguise, really.
Yeah, it was a blessing in disguise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to the diagnosis, it wasn't a fracture or anything of the sort.
It seems she'll be able to enter the Mile CS
in about two months without issue, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won't be able to do any intense training for a while,
and it feels like I'm gonna have way too much free time...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So because of that, I've been feeling a bit down, or maybe...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"Right. So you'll have some free time.
In that case..."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan, would it be okay if I came to see you for a little while?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh, your older sister did!?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I don't have any location shoots for a while,
so I should be able to drop by pretty often.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Trainer, got a sec?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really!?
Yay yay, yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's talk about all kinds of things!
I wanna hear what Big Sis has been up to lately, too!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course! Nice to meet you!
I just wanted to cheer Biko-chan up, even if only a little.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
A true hero smiles brightest in a pinch!
Right?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A brief period of recuperation.
And so, until the Mile Championship, Big Sis made a point to visit frequently.
